description: Per trait value of an NFT collection: how many assets have it, how many are listed and the cheapest listing (floor, ADA), and the sales in the window with their average and highest price. Only assets whose traits have been read are included; the answer says how many of the collection that is (`coverage`). Use it to price a trait.

days.description: Window for the sales in days: 7, 30, 90 or 365.

limit.description: How many trait values to return (1-100, default 25).

policyId.description: NFT policy id: 56 hex characters. Get it from `search` or `list_nft_collections`.

name: get_nft_trait_prices
title: NFT trait prices
